newsitem.title: CHINA: Gore says China funding to U.S. would be serious.
newsitem.headline: Gore says China funding to U.S. would be serious.

text.p: U.S. Vice President Al Gore said on Wednesday it would be a serious matter if allegations of Chinese funding to the U.S. Democratic Party were proved true.
"Should the allegations be proved to be true, I made it clear (to Chinese leaders) that would be serious indeed," Gore told a news conference.
Gore said the issue did not come up in his meeting with President Jiang Zemin on Wednesday but it was discussed with Premier Li Peng on Tuesday.
The investigation should not affect Sino-U.S. relations, but if the allegations were proved true the impact could be serious, he said.
Asked if the funding issue would cloud the development of Sino-U.S. relations while the investigation was being conducted, he said: "No, I take a longer term view."

The Washington Post has reported that the Federal Bureau of Investigation warned six members of Congress last year they had been targeted by China to receive illegal campaign funds from foreign corporations.
